method: Codex-led bounded trial using Scout's live preparation and review contracts; no production worker, database import or identity allocation.

seeds: Housing Authority of Salt Lake City
listPages.caution: Provider pages supersede old URLs and hours in the guide.
County funding/administration is not itself an application for a home.
Same publisher as county-list; not an independent fifth list publisher.
Used for seeds, not current capacity or loan terms.
An old statewide COVID assistance link is not proof of an open program.

seedBoundary: Extracted relevant program names for the nine kinds, not every organization mentioned in the full general-purpose lists. Repeated seeds merged before investigation. Generic 211 navigation, utility-only HEAT/REACH, development funding and ordinary emergency shelters were screened out at the list stage. Other named providers were not automatically promoted into leads when a kind already had sufficient direct routes.

additionalSeedRoutes.checklist-gap: Named Provo exemplars (HomeInn, Ruff Haven) or targeted searches for transitional housing, fixed-income shared housing and extended-stay lodging.
additionalSeedRoutes.official-list-followup: Salt Lake City housing-stability pages reached while finding its official resources.
additionalSeedRoutes.county-list-followup: The Road Home was a county seed; followed its veteran housing program and public outreach flyer.
additionalSeedRoutes.official-authority-link: Housing Connect's official application link led to AffordableHousing.com, then its Salt Lake City rental search.

notSelected.name: NeighborWorks Salt Lake down-payment assistance
notSelected.reason: Current program page says no Salt Lake City down-payment funds, with a limited Midvale option. CDCU already provides a homebuyer route. This bounded trial does not label NeighborWorks closed or unsuitable in every program.
notSelected.rule: current availability and bounded selection; no agency-wide failure

notSelected.name: Utah Housing Corporation homebuyer loan programs
notSelected.reason: Local lists and an official 2023 loan guide identify the program, but the consumer landing page returned 403. Did not carry old loan terms into a fresh record; the kind has a current local counseling route. No closure is inferred.
notSelected.rule: current consumer access evidence incomplete in this bounded pass

notSelected.name: Aspen Living Utah shared housing
notSelected.reason: Provider search-index pages offer direct conversations but also tie placement to HRSS/Medicaid and describe a referral network. No clear rent or ordinary fixed-income eligibility was established. A targeted page open failed. Do not claim affordable general self-referral housing from those fragments.
notSelected.rule: 3: distinguish a public inquiry from admission limited to an enrolled/referral pathway

notSelected.name: One New Light (Provo checklist example)
notSelected.reason: Exact-name searches did not establish a matching provider or Salt Lake County service. A checklist example is not evidence of local availability.

notSelected.name: The Road Home shared-housing program
notSelected.reason: A 2019 launch article and an older provider success story describe shared housing, but no current standalone self-application route was established. SSVF is a distinct, evidenced public route and is retained.
notSelected.rule: 3: current direct access to this specific program unestablished

churchChecks.finding: Official locator attempted but inaccessible to this reader. The official locations index routed Welfare Locations to Home Storage Centers. No direct Housing program established; no local housing record invented.
Official store locator inspected; thrift/employment route, no evidenced Housing offering.
Official locator entry and services describe job coaching, not a Housing program.
Official office-finder entry describes mental-health support and leader referrals, not direct housing.
Official index points to Institutes; no direct Housing program established.

gaps.label: Low-cost shared housing for fixed incomes
tried: Aspen Living targeted check after the baseline comparison surfaced its name
gaps.reason: No currently evidenced low-cost fixed-income shared-housing admission route passed the direct-access check. HomeInn has low-cost rooms and shared amenities, but neither that nor Aspen proves this specific kind. This is a research gap, not proof that no local service exists.

additions.label: Tenant support and eviction prevention
additions.reason: One-to-one rental navigation and landlord–tenant mediation help preserve a tenancy even when no rent grant or new unit is offered.
additions.status: proposed checklist addition; not an office taxonomy migration

stopReason: Each original kind has an evidenced local route or a documented gap; no more leads were sought to reach the expected 20–30. Three transitional options address single-room adults, young adults and single-parent families. HomeInn was a final checklist-named check because the first two transitional options did not cover an ordinary adult.
